content.short: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by daily trading volume.
content.description: Binance, founded in 2017, is the largest cryptocurrency exchange in the world by daily trading volume. It enables traders to securely store assets and execute trades using crypto wallets. For developers, Binance offers access to its API, allowing them to seamlessly integrate trading features into their own programs, with spot trading cited as a principal example of what can be achieved through API access.
